title: Radionuclides proportion and radiological risk assessment of soil samples collected in Covenant University, Ota, Ogun State Nigeria
author: Adewoyin, Omeje, et al.

steps.title: Define sampling grid and collect soil
steps.instruction: At the CUCRID, Senate, Sports Complex, and Café 1 buildings, mark a 1 m × 1 m square at each location, place sampling points at the four diagonal corners spaced 16 m apart, and collect four soil cores per point from 0–15 cm depth, yielding a total of 16 samples.

steps.title: Label, bag, and transport samples
steps.instruction: Place each core into a labeled plastic bag for easy identification, then transport all 16 bags to the Covenant University Chemistry Research Laboratory.

steps.title: Oven‑dry samples
steps.instruction: Dry each bagged sample in an oven at 105–110 °C until constant weight is achieved.

steps.title: Grind and sieve to fine powder
steps.instruction: Using a mortar and pestle, crush the dried soil to a fine powder, then pass it through a 75 µm mesh to remove dried leaves and stone pebbles.

steps.title: Weigh 60 g aliquot
steps.instruction: Weigh exactly 60 g of the sieved powder with an analytical balance and transfer it into a new labeled plastic bag.

steps.title: Ship prepared samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Package the 60 g aliquots securely and send them to Activation Laboratories Limited in Canada.

steps.title: Load samples into tin canisters
steps.instruction: In the analysis lab, place each 60 g sample into a 2 oz seamless tin canister (2⅙ in diameter × 1⅜ in height) and seal the lid with electrical tape.

steps.title: Equilibrate sealed canisters
steps.instruction: Store the sealed canisters for four weeks to achieve secular equilibrium between parent ^238U/^232Th and their daughter radionuclides.

steps.title: Acquire gamma spectra
steps.instruction: Measure each canister on a high‑resolution gamma spectrometer for a counting time of 10 000 s.

steps.title: Calculate radionuclide activities
steps.instruction: Determine ^226Ra (from ^214Pb and ^214Bi peaks) and ^232Th (from ^212Pb and ^228Ac peaks) activities according to the referenced methods.
